fact: RSTP reports INIC presented the beta version of the Portal do Cidadão at its 18th anniversary ceremony, with the Prime Minister calling it the launch of the portal.
India's MEA brief says the National Citizen Portal (gov.st), enabling access to public services through National ID-based login, was launched on 27 March 2026.

São Tomé and Príncipe's foreign ministry launched a Document Issuance System at its embassy in Portugal, letting the diaspora request birth certificates, the national identity card, criminal record certificates and certificates of legal capacity to marry through a digital portal of the Directorate-General for Registry and Notary.
